title.en: An Act to Consider the Late Manuel De Yriarte Retired Under Act Numbered Twenty-Five Hundred and Eighty-Nine, as Amended.

text.en:
The late Manuel de Yriarte, Director of the National Museum, who rendered faithful and
satisfactory service in the Government during more than twenty years, is hereby considered retired in
accordance with the provisions of Act Numbered Twenty-five hundred and eighty-nine, as amended by Act
Numbered Thirty-three hundred and sixty, and for the purpose hereof, said retirement shall be as effective as
if an application therefor had been filed after December fourth, nineteen hundred and twenty-seven, and as if
the same had been acted upon favorably prior to June thirtieth, nineteen hundred and twenty-eight.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 22, 1930.
